entities.name: Marko Simonović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marko Simonović is a Serbian professional basketball coach and former professional basketball player who is the current head coach for Sutjeska of the Prva A Liga and ABA League Second Division. As a player, he represented the senior Serbian national basketball team internationally. Standing at 2.03 m, he played at the small forward position.
